question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.season,
        t1.team_long_name AS team_name,
        c.name AS country_name,
        l.name AS league_name,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t1 ON m.home_team_api_id = t1.team_api_id
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.season,
        t2.team_long_name AS team_name,
        c.name AS country_name,
        l.name AS league_name,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t2 ON m.away_team_api_id = t2.team_api_id
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        season,
        team_name,
        country_name,
        league_name,
        CAST(SUM(points) AS INTEGER) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY league_id, season, team_name, country_name, league_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_name,
        country_name,
        team_name,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_name ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT season, league_name, country_name, team_name, total_points
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season, league_name
